record.question: Identify the incorrect combination
options: Cross head and guides: sliding pair
A bolt and nut: turning pair
A ball and socket joint: spherical pair
Ball bearing and roller bearing: rolling pair
record.explanation: A bolt and nut form a helical (screw) pair, not a turning (revolute) pair, so option B is the incorrect combination. The other pairings are standard: cross head and guides are a sliding pair, a ball and socket joint is a spherical pair, and ball or roller bearings are rolling pairs.
